summary: Unlock your potential in public procurement and contract management. Enroll in our training course to gain valuable insights and practical skills for success.
lede: Public procurement training helps procurement officers, contract managers, project managers, and internal auditors plan purchases and manage contracts with clear, defensible records. Participants practise assessing needs and markets, choosing procurement routes, setting and scoring tender criteria, tracking supplier performance, and documenting contract changes, using practical templates and digital records; the course also introduces spreadsheet dashboards and AI-assisted analytics at an awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, approve, evaluate, administer, audit, or report on publicly funded procurement and contracts. It suits foundation-to-intermediate practitioners who need a stronger operational method without requiring legal specialization or programming experience.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if available. Participants should have access to anonymized examples of procurement plans, tender documents, contract registers, or supplier performance records for contextual application. Local policies, approval thresholds, and legal requirements remain the controlling sources for workplace implementation.
